sloka: भू तले सागरे वा अपि शैलेषु च वनेषु च ।पातालस्य अपि वा मध्ये न मम आच्छिद्यते गतिः ॥४-४५-१६॥
transliteration: bhū tale sāgare vā api śaileṣu ca vaneṣu ca ।pātālasya api vā madhye na mama ācchidyate gatiḥ ॥4-45-16॥

translations.english: Then the vanaras there, proud of their strength, spoke thus one after another in the presence of the king of vanaras.
